metadata.description: Multi-informant rating-scale family for ADHD symptoms, executive difficulties, and related behavior in children and adolescents.
metadata.intended_use: Clinical and educational assessment using parent, teacher, and self-report perspectives.
metadata.name_origin: Conners 3 is the third edition of the Conners behavior-rating family.
metadata.development_history: Maintained as an age- and informant-specific rating-scale system with multiple forms.
metadata.measurement_rationale: Cross-informant ratings capture behavior across home and school contexts and support hypothesis generation.
metadata.interpretation_notes: Commercial norms and clinical interpretation are edition-specific; ratings alone do not establish an ADHD diagnosis.
